high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "spaceman.in." The post features a visually striking image of a galaxy, specifically highlighting the Milky Way. The galaxy is depicted with a bright central region radiating outwards into numerous thin, yellowish streams that resemble the spokes of a wheel or the tentacles of a jellyfish. The background is dark, emphasizing the brightness of the galaxy. The text overlay on the image reads: "Our galaxy, along with Andromeda, and a handful of other galaxies, are bound together in what is known as the Local Group.
